visual.title: The band inside the column
visual.caption: The B column has width P(B) and the A band inside it has height P(A|B). Their product is the area of the overlap, which is the multiplication rule drawn rather than asserted.

predict.question: P(A ∩ B) equals:
predict.explain: The overlap inside the B column has area P(B) × P(A|B), which is the multiplication rule. Here 0.4 × 0.8 = 0.32.
